final: WITH high_fees AS (SELECT f.orderslink, f.feerate, f.rebrate, o.dealedge FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009), group_stats AS (SELECT orderslink, dealedge, AVG(feerate - rebrate) as group_avg_net_fee, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM high_fees GROUP BY orderslink, dealedge), side_stats AS (SELECT dealedge, AVG(group_avg_net_fee) as side_avg_net_fee FROM group_stats GROUP BY dealedge), filtered AS (SELECT gs.orderslink, gs.dealedge, gs.group_avg_net_fee, gs.record_count, ss.side_avg_net_fee, gs.group_avg_net_fee - ss.side_avg_net_fee as difference FROM group_stats gs JOIN side_stats ss ON gs.dealedge = ss.dealedge WHERE gs.group_avg_net_fee > ss.side_avg_net_fee) SELECT orderslink, dealedge, group_avg_net_fee, record_count, difference FROM filtered ORDER BY CASE WHEN difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference DESC LIMIT 10
